name: comic-text
title: Comic Text
description: Comic-book lettering: skewed uppercase letters with a halftone-dot fill, a heavy black outline and a stacked hard shadow, popping in with a small overshoot.
useWhen: An exclamation, sound effect or punchy label should look like comic-book lettering.
A playful promo needs a big pop-in word with a halftone look.
avoidWhen: The tone is quiet or corporate.
The text is longer than a few words: the outline gets heavy.
author: Magic UI

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The lettering. It is set in capitals.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Dot colour
variables.description: Halftone dots in the letters and the second shadow.

variables.label: Pop time
variables.description: Seconds the pop-in takes (the source uses 0.6).
